title: fix(spec): the packageless-overlay-write-closed prose names the ceremony's own-member move
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi94JJKezo6hNEcFJ8VTnfh4W)_
Fixes #29261

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改文字。未发布的升级条目 `packageless-overlay-write-closed`(ADR-0087 语义迁移)和它待发的 changeset 改写为：`os migrate packageless-overlays` 把「基础包没发的邮件模板语言」那一行作为 `.custom` 配对包自己的成员迁过去(不声明 `overrides`，结果 `moved` + `addedMember`)，而不再说它迁移失败、也不再说每次迁移都声明 `overrides`；该语言的无包写入在迁移前后都仍然开放。
- 为什么改：PR #29258 已让迁移命令这样做，但这两段文字仍是旧说法，会随发布说明和升级指南原样发出去，误导运维。
- 风险与回滚：无运行时改动，只影响升级指南与发布说明的文字。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.packageless-overlay-write-closed.ts`(replacement 与 reason 两段)、`.changeset/28576-packageless-overlay-write-closed.md`(`movable` 一条与 Still open 一条)。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:upgrade-guide`，预期 exit 0；生成的升级指南里出现 `addedMember`，不再有「such as an email template locale the base does not ship」。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Text only. No runtime file is touched.

- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.packageless-overlay-write-closed.ts` (unreleased ADR-0087 semantic entry):
  - `replacement`: `--apply` declares `overrides: { package, basedOn }` on each move, **except** a row of an email template locale the base does not ship (the preview names it `addedMember`), which moves as the pair's own member at that locale, declaring nothing, outcome `moved` with that `addedMember` in place of a `basedOn`. The "from then on" writes say an added member is written into the pair with no `overrides` and that its pair DELETE removes it. New sentence: an added member's package-less write stays open, before and after its move. The `failed` clause drops "such as an email template locale the base does not ship" from the pair-refusal example, and scopes the missing-version case to a declared override (the own-member move records no `basedOn`).
  - `reason`: the 403 applies to a movable row the command moves as a declared override; an email template locale the base does not ship keeps its package-less write. "The close reaches only what the command moves as a declared override".
  - `acceptanceCriteria`: "a save of a moved declared override" (an added member's save into the pair carries no `overrides`).
  - The header comment says the same.
  - `surface` is not touched (that is #29393's widening, not in this card's claim).
- `.changeset/28576-packageless-overlay-write-closed.md` (pending, from PR #28576's work, not yet released):
  - Headline, the `Clause-②:` prose and the `Metadata-protocol:` prose: "can move as a declared override". The two declaration tokens (`yes (narrowing)`, `narrowed`) are unchanged.
  - "Upgrade, then run the ceremony": the refusal covers what the command moves as a declared override; an own-member move keeps its write.
  - `movable` bullet: names both outcomes (`moved` with `basedOn`, `moved` with `addedMember`) and says the added member's package-less write stays open; the missing-version case is scoped to a declared override.
  - FROM → TO: one sentence for the email-locale case (write it into the pair with no `overrides`; one declaring the base is refused).
  - **Still open**: the email-template-locale case leaves the "the ceremony would not move" list (the ceremony now moves it) and becomes its own sentence: every package-less write of that locale stays open, before and after the move, because the close judges only the declared-override move and the override write gate refuses a declared override of that locale.

### What `main` does (measured at 32912139)

- The move: `migratePackagelessOverlays` saves an `addedMember` row into the pair without `overrides` and pushes `{ outcome: 'moved', packageId, addedMember }` ([L519–L560](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/329121397b395e688cff1ca9e845e07ba53c652a/packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packageless-overlay-migration.ts#L519-L560)). A missing base version fails only a declared-override move ([L515–L516](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/329121397b395e688cff1ca9e845e07ba53c652a/packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packageless-overlay-migration.ts#L515-L516)).
- The close: `packagelessCloseSubject` builds the DECLARED body (`overrides: { package: base, basedOn }`) and asks the override write gate; a refusal returns `null`, the write stays open ([L711–L718](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/329121397b395e688cff1ca9e845e07ba53c652a/packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packageless-overlay-migration.ts#L711-L718)). The gate refuses a declared override at a locale the base does not ship, so every package-less write of that member (save, delete, publish, rollback; a stored row or none, so before and after the move) is left open. Pinned on main by `packages/objectql/src/environment-overlay-email-locale-restart.test.ts` "the reset (?member=): an unshipped member … (its package-less reset stays open)" ([L906](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/329121397b395e688cff1ca9e845e07ba53c652a/packages/objectql/src/environment-overlay-email-locale-restart.test.ts#L906)) beside its CONTROL "a shipped member's unmigrated row: its package-less reset door is closed" (L912).

## Tests

No test is added or edited (prose only; no test pins this entry's text: `git grep` for the entry id and for the old phrase hits only the two edited files, the #28905 changeset's reference to the id, and an unrelated dogfood comment).

- `packages/spec` migrations suite, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/migrations` after `gen:migration-registry`, on d241313d: Test Files 5 passed (5), Tests 195 passed (195).
- Upgrade-guide generator: `check:upgrade-guide` exit 0 (in-memory, protocol 18.0.0, 2 hop sections); `check:spec-changes` exit 0. Generated to a scratch file with `--out`: `addedMember` 1 hit, the dropped phrase "such as an email template locale the base does not ship" 0 hits. The docs pages (`content/docs/protocol-upgrade/`) are gitignored, so no regenerated reference rides this PR.
- `packages/metadata-protocol`: no test pins this prose (zero `git grep` hits), so not run; the runtime is unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- **Check Changeset is red by design.** This PR edits a PENDING changeset another PR added (`.changeset/28576-packageless-overlay-write-closed.md`) to remove sentences #29258 made false. `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main` exits 1 with the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class; the remedy it prints is "do NOT restore it — say so on the PR". It is not restored and `skip-changeset` is not added. This PR adds no changeset of its own: the entry is unreleased, and its text ships with the edited changeset's release.
- Not touched, outside this card: `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`'s ADR-0146 paragraph still says a pre-D11 row's "package-less save, reset and rollback are refused once movable (D11)", which an added-locale row (movable, write open) contradicts. A governed surface; reported to the seat, not edited here.

## Verification

- `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`: exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, shallow clone) on the first pass; after `git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a487607881c66b2899b7e3477115229a156b4` exit 0, 48 cases pass.
- `check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main`: exit 1, DELIBERATE CORRECTION class on `.changeset/28576-packageless-overlay-write-closed.md` (see Acceptance notes). Not restored, no `skip-changeset`.
